//Identity: Throwaway OIDC keys and a throwaway purpose-token key for a local run only: a deployed boot refuses them, so a dev target's settings file sets IsEphemeral to false and carries its certificates (vault secrets), and Identity:Tokens:SigningKey. A local run may also leave Identity:DataProtection:Certificates empty and keep the ring unwrapped; its database comes from appsettings.Local.json or DB_CONNECTION. Point Identity:Email:Smtp at a local mail sink (appsettings.Local.json) to read the emails of a run.
//Telegram: A local run reads the bot by polling, never by webhook: appsettings.Local.json sets Identity:Telegram:IsEnabled, BotToken, BotUserName and UpdateMode Polling for a bot of its own (a hosted instance's bot answers 409 to polling), or Identity:TestMode:IsEnabled true for a fake bot and every code or link at GET /api/test/messages?to=. A deployed boot refuses both Polling and test mode, so this file leaves them off.
